_readme: Calendar config for tools/build_science.py. 'translations': Russian text from the source calendars -> English text on the site (empty = not yet translated, the event is left out). For rows without a facility link, write the English as 'Title: text'. 'links': English title -> URL for rows without a facility/mission card. 'exclude': rows containing 'match' are never published. Rules that would themselves reveal non-public information go into the local, git-ignored data/private.json instead.
